title: 第13课 · 门开着呢
subtitle: HSK 2 · Lesson 13 — 门开着呢 · The door is open

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在办公室 — In the office

items.py: A: Mén kāizhe ne, qǐng jìn.
items.en: A: The door's open, come in.

items.py: B: Qǐngwèn, Zhāng xiānsheng zài ma?
items.en: B: Excuse me, is Mr Zhang in?

items.zh: A：他出去了。你下午再来吧。
items.py: A: Tā chūqu le. Nǐ xiàwǔ zài lái ba.
items.en: A: He's gone out. Come back this afternoon.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在办公室 — In the office

items.zh: A：那个正在说话的女孩儿是谁？
items.py: A: Nàge zhèngzài shuō huà de nǚháir shì shéi?
items.en: A: Who's the girl who's talking?

items.zh: B：我知道她的名字，她姓杨，叫杨笑笑，她姐姐是我同学。
items.py: B: Wǒ zhīdào tā de míngzi, tā xìng Yáng, jiào Yáng Xiàoxiao, tā jiějie shì wǒ tóngxué.
items.en: B: I know her name — Yang Xiaoxiao. Her elder sister is my classmate.

items.zh: A：那个手里拿着铅笔的呢？
items.py: A: Nàge shǒu li názhe qiānbǐ de ne?
items.en: A: And the one holding a pencil?

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在运动场 — On the playground

items.zh: A：听说你有女朋友了？我认识她吗？
items.py: A: Tīngshuō nǐ yǒu nǚpéngyou le? Wǒ rènshi tā ma?
items.en: A: I hear you've got a girlfriend. Do I know her?

items.zh: B：就是我们班那个长着两个大眼睛，非常爱笑的女孩儿。
items.py: B: Jiù shì wǒmen bān nàge zhǎngzhe liǎng ge dà yǎnjing, fēicháng ài xiào de nǚháir.
items.en: B: She's the girl in our class with big eyes who's always smiling.

items.py: A: Tā bú shì yǒu nánpéngyou ma?
items.en: A: Doesn't she have a boyfriend?

items.zh: B：那个已经是她的前男友了。
items.py: B: Nàge yǐjīng shì tā de qián nányǒu le.

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 在路上 — On the road

items.zh: A：请问，这儿离新京宾馆远吗？
items.py: A: Qǐngwèn, zhèr lí Xīnjīng Bīnguǎn yuǎn ma?
items.en: A: Excuse me, is the Xinjing Hotel far from here?

items.zh: B：不远，走路二十分钟就到。
items.py: B: Bù yuǎn, zǒu lù èrshí fēnzhōng jiù dào.
items.en: B: Not far, about 20 minutes on foot.

items.py: A: Nǐ néng gàosu wǒ zěnme zǒu ma?
items.en: A: Can you tell me how to get there?

items.zh: B：从这儿一直往前走，到了前面的路口再往右走。
items.py: B: Cóng zhèr yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu, dàole qiánmiàn de lùkǒu zài wǎng yòu zǒu.
items.en: B: Go straight ahead from here, then turn right at the crossing.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (结构助词“着”: ongoing state)
语法 · Grammar (反问句“不是……吗”)

items.zh: 不是说今天有雨吗？怎么没下？
items.py: Bú shì shuō jīntiān yǒu yǔ ma? Zěnme méi xià?
items.en: Didn't they say it would rain today? Why hasn't it?

items.zh: 你不是北京人吗？怎么不会说北京话？
items.py: Nǐ bú shì Běijīng rén ma? Zěnme bú huì shuō Běijīng huà?
items.en: Aren't you from Beijing? How come you can't speak the dialect?

items.py: Tā bú shì yǒu nánpéngyou le ma?
items.en: Doesn't she have a boyfriend already?

items.zh: 从这儿往前走，就是我们学校。
items.py: Cóng zhèr wǎng qián zǒu, jiù shì wǒmen xuéxiào.
items.en: Go ahead from here and you'll reach our school.

items.zh: 往左走是医院，往右走是银行。
items.py: Wǎng zuǒ zǒu shì yīyuàn, wǎng yòu zǒu shì yínháng.
items.en: Left is the hospital, right is the bank.

items.zh: 从这儿一直往前走，到了前面的路口再往右走。
items.py: Cóng zhèr yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu, dàole qiánmiàn de lùkǒu zài wǎng yòu zǒu.
items.en: Go straight ahead, then right at the crossing.
How do you get to the Xinjing Hotel?
